# nnbsp name

The space between `nnbsp` and `name` is U+202F, NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE.
Obsidian folds U+202F in paths but not in link text, so in Obsidian this file
is indexed under a plain space and no link typed with U+202F ever reaches it.
That asymmetry is Obsidian's own bug, recorded rather than fixed.
